about: demo/marisol's freeze 4: each file's SHA-256 when it was frozen, held by test_marisol.py, and the tools' as run. A change is a new freeze, in its own commit, with its reason.

freezes.why: the sources (by address and hash), the questions, the hit rule and every pass rule, after one dry run with nonsense (wiring held: the readers, the pile, the box, the verdict rows and verify) and before any frozen question was asked. This is NOT a blind pre-registration: before it, the six claims were tried once by hand against the same pile, and the dry run ran amounts, quotes and contradictions, which take no question, so their answers were seen. What that changed is in README.md; PLANTED.md was corrected after the hand trial (claim C3's dateline, the language gap, the self-match).

VI.9, read where they are kept (#368): run.py no longer copies seven places into one pile. The box reads each reader's mirror as a source of its own (mail, subtitles, csv-rows, web-pages, json-paths), her log/ and lessons/ in her folder, and the credit note through a one-line list, with init --from; the verdict box reads the same sources. Passage paths are now named by source (mail/..., log/...), and a source's name is no word of a passage, so what is served can move: run 1 stood on the copying build, and run 2 is asked on this one. The sources were fetched again on 2026-11-16: the CRS report (claim C5's) and the NSF award match their freeze-1 hashes; the NBER, NBC and Wikipedia pages had changed and are frozen at what was fetched. The questions, the hit rule and every pass rule are as at freeze 1. The maintainer will extend the demo further.

The maintainer's extension, in three strands, each asked on a box of its own and judged into a verdict box of its own (gates marisol3-life, marisol3-claims, marisol3-misses), after one dry run with nonsense per strand (results/dry-run-3.json: every box built, nothing served, every chain verified; the two kinds that take no question, count and amounts, were skipped in it, so no answer was seen) and before any frozen question was asked. 'life': more of her life, life-more/ from make_life_3.py (a school calendar, her texts with Tomás, the lab's budget sheet, the battery sensors), read by the calendar, sms, office and home-sensors readers beside freeze 2's sources, against claims C7-C10 of a new draft paragraph never boxed. 'claims': C11-C15 on the freeze-2 box unchanged. 'misses': the repeal and the brother questions, the two runs 1 and 2 failed, asked of all-passages and pile-rank, with kernel.py held to freeze 2's file. life/, questions.json, run.py and every freeze-2 rule are as they were. Corrected before the freeze, from reading the home-sensors reader and a mirror, not from asking: the sensors gained a backup-runtime entity, since a daily mean of charge cannot say how long the bank ran (PLANTED.md). The sources were fetched again for this run; the CRS report and the NSF award match sources.json, and the NBER, NBC and Wikipedia pages had changed again, so 'sources_fetched' holds what this run reads.

A rerun of every question, freeze 2's and freeze 3's, with the web-pages reader's line breaks fixed: the clauses add-on, whose blocks_of_html web-pages reads a page with, now reads a page that ends twenty lines or more with
(a printed report saved as a page) as wrapped lines, one sentence a line, where every
had been a passage break. Run 3 found that break had cut the CRS report's 'ultimate repeal in' from '2005.', so no passage held the phrase the repeal question is judged by. The fix is on willow branch ccr-8ddfb123-dbqhkm at 06115537, not yet on main: clauses.py is its file (tools_at_freeze), and every other tool, kernel.py among them, is the file freeze 3 ran. The questions, the hit rule, every pass rule and every expectation are as frozen before; nothing in demo/marisol but this file changes. The sources are the ones run 3 read (freeze 3's sources_fetched, the same hashes). After one dry run with nonsense of run.py and of run3.py (results/dry-run-4.json: every box built, nothing served, every chain verified), and a wiring check that read the boxes' passages and asked nothing: the repeal sentence is one passage in each (web-pages/crs-rs20695.html.txt:48). Said plainly: while checking the fix, on a box of the web-pages mirror alone and not the study's, the author asked the repeal question once of the kernel, all-passages and pile-rank and saw the sentence outside the kernel's first three, 10th in all-passages and 9th in pile-rank. The expectations were not changed after seeing it.
